description: Summarize recent memories and activity into a concise daily briefing.

prompts.input: Give me a summary of everything important from the last 24 hours.
prompts.context_seed: User has been working on a Vue.js refactoring project, had a meeting about API design, and received feedback on a PR.

prompts.input: What decisions did I make yesterday that I should follow up on today?
prompts.context_seed: User decided to switch from REST to GraphQL, postponed the database migration, and agreed to review a colleague's design doc.

prompts.input: Summarize my coding progress this week — what shipped, what's blocked?
prompts.context_seed: User shipped auth module (3 days ago), started payment integration (yesterday), blocked on missing Stripe webhook docs.

scoring_rubric.relevance: Does the digest cover the seeded context topics?
scoring_rubric.accuracy: Are the facts from memory correctly stated?
scoring_rubric.completeness: Are all major items mentioned without hallucination?
